title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months | TechCrunch
summary: Israeli-Dutch AI startup Wonderful has raised $550 million in a Series C funding round that gives it a price tag of $5 billion, more than doubling the $2 billion valuation the company gained when it last raised funding nearly six months ago…
